title: Oven Roasted Slovakian Cheese Casserole
description: A rich and fluffy post-workout Slovakian dish featuring candied peel and high protein content, cooked to perfection in a robata grill vessel.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill vessel to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, sour cream, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the crumbled feta cheese, shredded cheddar, chopped parsley, and candied peel to the bowl and stir until just combined.
Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a large rectangle.
Spoon the cheese mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Use a sharp knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pastry for ventilation.
Place the casserole in the preheated robata grill vessel and bake for 35 minutes.
Rotate the casserole and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
